transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I've just been feeling incredibly down and sad for about a year and a half now, and it never seems to go away. It's gotten to the point where I just can't shake this heavy, depressed mood anymore. That's really why I finally decided to seek help.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite of depressed—like your mood was unusually high, you had racing thoughts, or you felt like you didn't need to sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have really only felt depressed and low, and I've never had those kinds of high-energy periods. It's just been a constant heavy feeling.
Along with feeling down, have you also been struggling with excessive, uncontrollable worry or anxiety about everyday things?
No, I wouldn't say I struggle with that kind of constant worry. It's not really anxiety that's the problem, but more just a deep, heavy sadness that I can't seem to shake.
During this past year and a half, have you had any periods lasting two months or longer where you felt completely back to your normal, non-depressed self?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. The depression and low energy have been completely continuous and constant for the entire year and five months. I haven't felt like my normal self since this all started.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in doing things you used to enjoy, or is it mostly just the low mood you're experiencing?

It's definitely more of the persistent low mood and a deep, constant sadness. I feel this heavy emptiness and emotional numbness inside, rather than just a loss of interest in things. It just feels like my emotions are completely flat and hollow all the time.
Have you ever experienced a period earlier in your life where you felt this same kind of low mood continuously for two full years or longer?

No, I don't recall ever experiencing a low mood that lasted that long in the past. This current struggle has been going on for about a year and a half, but before this, I've never had anything last for two years or more.
How has your sleep been during this time—are you having trouble sleeping, or perhaps sleeping much more than usual?
Honestly, I haven't noticed any major changes in my sleep patterns. I seem to sleep about the same as I always have, so I don't think that has been a problem for me.
Have you recently heard or seen things that others couldn't, or held strong beliefs that other people found unusual or unrealistic?

No, I don't hear or see things that aren't there, but I do hold a strong belief that others tell me makes no sense. I feel deeply responsible for all the terrible misfortunes and disasters happening in the world, and I truly believe I deserve to be punished for them.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight since this low mood started, or has that remained mostly the same?
No, I haven't noticed any significant changes in my appetite or my weight. They have both remained pretty much the same since this all started.

Did you start believing you were responsible for these world disasters only after you began feeling this deep sadness, or did you hold this belief even during times when you weren't feeling depressed?

Yes, I only started believing that after this deep sadness and depression began about a year and five months ago. I never held those beliefs or felt that way before this heavy mood took over. It definitely started once the depression set in.
